messages:
Emma S: customer reporting 400 from /v1/rerank, error text: \"items must be a non-empty array\". They say payload looks fine on their side. Pasting sample below.
Liam E: can you paste the raw request body and headers? especially Content-Type and any proxy in front.
Emma S: curl they provided: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"queries":[{"query":"who wrote dune"}],"candidates":"[]","top_k":"5"}'
```
Emma S: note: they have candidates as a quoted string and top_k as a string. They said their mobile proxy 'enriches' bodies, not sure if it touched this.
Omar S: that explains it — candidates must be a JSON array of candidate objects (not a JSON string). top_k should be integer. When candidates is a string we parse it as a scalar and validate fails -> 400. Seen similar with SDK envelope v1.1 where arrays get stringified when metadata is appended.
Liam E: quick repro: if you send \`\"candidates\":\"[]\"\` we return 400. If you send \`\"candidates\":[]\` and each element has {\"id\":..., \"text\":...} it returns 200. Also if top_k is quoted -> validation error.
Sara I: marking as priority for SDK/Proxy docs. I'll add a small bullet to the troubleshooting guide: check for double-stringified arrays from proxies and verify Content-Type not overwritten.
qa-bot: repro checklist added to ticket SUPPORT-1187: steps -> 1) proxy on, request body mutated -> 400 ; 2) bypass proxy with same client -> 200 ; 3) fix client to send native array -> 200. Attach logs.
Liam E: infra note: nginx body_filter modules sometimes coerce JSON when adding headers. Omar, can you check proxy rules for mobile APIGW? Filed INF-4321.
Emma S: suggested interim workaround to customer: ensure Content-Type: application/json and change top_k to a number, and confirm candidates is not wrapped in quotes. Provided example:
```
{"queries":[{"query":"who wrote dune"}],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Frank Herbert"}],"top_k":5}
```
Emma S: customer replied they patched proxy and confirmed 200 now. Closing after they verify full traffic. :thumbsup:
